# Public detector smoke fixtures

Two small raster fixtures copied without modification from
[QyooDetector-iOS at 021becc](https://github.com/qyoocode/QyooDetector-iOS/tree/021becc75bd35834007aeca7a2db0f6451e8692c/Tests/QyooDetectorTests/Fixtures),
with expected payloads and SHA-256 digests retained in `manifest.json`.
These are generated test rasters, not photographs.

`single_bit_17.png` contains one set payload bit with expected numeric value
262144. `negative_gray.png` is a blank rejection control. They establish a
reproducible public smoke check, not a general camera benchmark.
Repository Qyoo software licensing applies; external CML and GD retain their
own licenses as described in the top-level third-party notices.
